lines: •Raising 2026 Earnings Guidance Range to $5.35 to $5.55 per Diluted Share
•Establishing 2027 Earnings Guidance Range of $5.70 to $5.90 per Diluted Share
•Issuing EPS Compound Annual Growth Rate Guidance of 8% to 10% for 2027 through 2031, using the 2027 Guidance Midpoint as the Base
Today, Ameren is raising its 2026 earnings guidance range to $5.35 to $5.55 from $5.25 to $5.45 per share.
Further, Ameren expects 2027 diluted earnings per share to be in a range of $5.70 to $5.90 per share, representing 8.4% growth from the original 2026 guidance midpoint.
Ameren expects diluted earnings per share to grow at an 8% to 10% compound annual rate from 2027 through 2031, using the 2027 guidance range midpoint of $5.80 per share as the base.
